integrity: Exact determinant argument plus independently run finite checks; no extrapolation from experiments is used in proof. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the first positive F-jumping invariant is determined; further test ideals, Hilbert–Kunz multiplicities, and F-signatures are outside scope.
The binary case is already implied by previous extremal results; the claimed new result is the N>=3 pointwise and arithmetic classification.
Historical priority remains provisional pending specialist literature review.
title: Complete rank-stratified F-pure thresholds of finite-field hyperplane arrangements
